_meta.name: MoveMarket source of truth: UI copy (English)
_meta.rule: UI memakai bahasa Inggris karena juri global. Semua teks yang tampil ke pengguna diambil dari file ini lewat key. Hindari kata gamble dan bet di UI; pakai predict, stake, pool.

errors.PRF_UNAVAILABLE: This passkey provider is not supported yet. Try saving the passkey in iCloud Keychain, Google Password Manager, or 1Password.
errors.FAUCET_FAILED: Test tokens were not sent yet. Please try again in a moment.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_GAS: Out of gas funds. Refilling from the faucet.
errors.GAS_REFILL_FAILED: Out of gas funds and the refill did not arrive. Try again in a moment.
errors.MarketNotOpen: This market no longer accepts predictions.
errors.INDEXER_OFFLINE: Rankings and history are temporarily unavailable.
errors.CRYPTO_UNAVAILABLE: This browser cannot create passkey accounts. Try a recent Chrome or Safari.
errors.SESSION_ENDED: Your session ended. Unlock with your passkey again.
errors.ACCOUNT_MISMATCH: This passkey belongs to a different account.
errors.GAS_TOPUP_LIMIT: Gas refill limit reached. Please try again tomorrow.
errors.GAS_NOT_MEASURED: Claim all is not available yet. Claim each market on its own.
errors.BACKUP_CANCELLED: Adding a backup passkey was cancelled.
errors.BACKUP_NOT_FOUND: No backup passkey is saved for this account.
errors.BACKUP_DECRYPT_FAILED: This passkey could not open the backup.
errors.BACKUP_LIMIT: This account already has the maximum number of backup passkeys.
errors.BACKUP_RATE_LIMIT: Too many backup changes from this network. Please try again tomorrow.
errors.BACKUP_SAVE_FAILED: The backup was not saved. Please try again.
errors.ADDRESS_INVALID: Enter a valid account address (0x followed by 40 characters).

ui.footer: Monad Testnet only. Test tokens have no value.

game.noOpen: Nothing open right now. New markets open every few plies.
game.noInPlay: Locked markets wait here for their plies.
game.noResults: Final results from Chainlink CRE land here.
game.notFound: This game is not being tracked.

stake.help: {min} to {max} tUSDC per market. {room} left in this one.
stake.feeNote: Payout moves as others stake until the market locks.

onboarding.title: Create your account
onboarding.lede: Use Face ID, Touch ID or your screen lock. No seed phrase, no extension. Everything runs on Monad Testnet and test tokens have no value.
onboarding.note: Your key is stored only encrypted, and this device keeps you signed in for {hours} hours.

me.title: Positions
me.noAccount: No account on this device yet.
me.noPositions: No positions yet. Pick Yes or No on an open market and it shows up here.

landing.lede: Call the next {plies} plies of a live chess game. Yes or No, {sec} seconds to decide. Chainlink CRE confirms every result on Monad.
landing.ledeShort: Yes or No on the next {plies} plies. {sec} seconds to decide. Chainlink CRE confirms every result on Monad.
landing.seeLocking: See what is about to lock
landing.dragHint: Drag the board to turn it
landing.resultsEmptyNote: as soon as a window settles

steps.title: Open
steps.text: {plies} plies, Yes or No, {sec} seconds to stake.

steps.title: Locked
steps.text: Closes when the ply before the window is played, or when time runs out.

steps.title: Provisional
steps.text: The resolver shows the outcome the moment it is known.

steps.title: Final
steps.text: Chainlink CRE reads Lichess and posts the result on Monad.

steps.title: Claim
steps.text: Winners split the pool minus {fee}%. Voided markets are refunded.

board.label3d: 3D board at ply {ply}. {last} Drag or use the arrow keys to turn it.
board.turnHint: Drag to turn, pinch or Ctrl + scroll to zoom, double-click to reset

backup.title: Backup passkeys
backup.lede: Add a second passkey on another device, like a phone or a security key. It opens this same account without a seed phrase.
backup.how: First confirm with the passkey you use now, then create the backup passkey.
backup.note: Anyone who holds a backup passkey can open this account. Removing one here only hides it from this list; a device that already saved it can still open the account.

restore.title: Restore your account
restore.lede: Use a backup passkey you added on another device. Enter the account address, or open the restore link you copied.
restore.choose: Choose the backup passkey that is on this device.
restore.done: Your account is restored on this device.
